encoding_model: multi-level one-hot; arcs keyed by ABSOLUTE own-frame-band codeword
codeword_semantics: Each arc's codeword is the set of CRAM cells hot in the mux's OWN frame-band groups (select fields + same-node enable groups) in a real specimen rbf. decode() forms the same set and requires an EXACT match; no match -> None.
decontamination: Physical frame-band audit at FULL (frame, data-row Y, bit-plane b) resolution. A device-file group is cross-cascade contamination iff ALL its cells fall in a DIFFERENT bound node's (frame,Y,b) select band -> STRIPPED. The FULL frame key (vs the earlier (Y,b)-only key) still strips the downstream neighbour's select cells but no longer over-strips a node's OWN enable group, which shares (Y,b) with the downstream select band but lives in a different frame. This keeps codewords context-invariant AND makes a driven mux require its enable hot, so a mere rung-tap-idle state is rejected (closes the LE-I0 tap-alias).
group_roles: SELECT groups vary across a node's arcs; ENABLE groups are constant-hot when the mux is driven; DORMANT groups never hot (excluded); FOREIGN groups lie in another bound node's (frame,Y,b) band (stripped).
validation: HELD-OUT only. coverage arcs grounded s42, cross-checked seed-invariant s7.
